! Title: Filter Bloat
! Description: Blocks page bloat that slows sites down
! Expires: 1 day
! Homepage: https://github.com/ndewing-equinix/filter-bloat
! Last modified: 2026-11-21T19:02Z

! Atlassian Cloud (Jira)

! AI agent sessions panel
atlassian.net##[data-testid="ai-agent-sessions."]
atlassian.net##[data-testid="ai-agent-sessions.agent-panel-empty-state"]
atlassian.net##[data-testid="ai-agent-sessions.title-container"]

! Forge app iframes
atlassian.net##[data-testid="hosted-resources-iframe"]

! Checklist app panel
atlassian.net##[data-testid^="issue-view-ecosystem.connect.content-panel.com.appbox.ai.checklist__"]

! Sidebar automation and app glances
atlassian.net##[data-vc="issue-view-automation-apps-panel"]

! Forge panel headers, by title
atlassian.net##div:has(> :is(h2,h3,button,span):has-text(/^Work item health$/))
atlassian.net##div:has(> div > h2:has-text(/^(Embeds|Checklist|Work item health)$/)):has([data-testid="issue-view-ecosystem.forge.meat-ball-menu"])
atlassian.net##div:has(> div > h2:has-text(/^(Embeds|Work item health)$/)):has([data-testid="issue-view-ecosystem.forge.meat-ball-menu"])
